subject: MAP: target close & procurement signature deadline
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Wu <samantha@fintechco.com>, Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@fintechco.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP draft + target close alignment

Hi Samantha / Oliver —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap and the MAP draft attached (FinTechCo_MAP_v0.3.xlsx). Per our discovery, main objectives are: reduce inference latency for realtime fraud checks and move batch retraining to a dedicated endpoint.

Proposed high-level milestones (draft):
- Milestone 1 (Tech review): Redwood provides architecture + perf baseline — due 2026-03-05 — owner: Marissa / Camila
- Milestone 2 (POC & perf validation): Test on sample workload — due 2026-03-12 — owner: FinTechCo
- Milestone 3 (Contract & procurement): Finalize SOW & contract signature — target 2026-03-22 — owner: Legal / Procurement
- Milestone 4 (Go-live prep): Capacity reservation + runbooks — due 2026-03-30 — owner: Redwood / FinTechCo

Target close we discussed was end of March; to keep procurement timelines aligned, I put a contract signature deadline of 2026-03-25 in the first pass of the MAP. If procurement needs an earlier signature, we can tighten the SOW/pricing milestone windows.

Dependencies noted in the MAP: SOC 2 attestation copy, standard IP language in SOW, and customer test dataset for perf validation. I flagged the SOC 2 doc request under "evidence" — we can share our SOC 2 summary and SOC 2 report under NDA if that helps procurement.

Next steps: please review the attached MAP and confirm: (1) whether procurement signature deadline should be 2026-03-22 or we should keep 2026-03-25, and (2) who on your side owns the POC test dataset delivery.

Attachments: FinTechCo_MAP_v0.3.xlsx (MAP draft), SOW_Draft_FTCO_v1.pdf (initial SOW draft)

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0193
From: Samantha Wu <samantha@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@fintechco.com>
Cc: procurement@fintechco.com
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP draft + target close alignment

Thanks Marissa — this is super helpful. Quick notes from procurement and legal:

- Procurement needs the contract signature by 2026-03-22 to align with our month-end budget release. If Redwood can commit to that date, we can route approvals accordingly.
- Legal still needs a copy of your SOC 2 summary / subservice org attestations. Can you share the SOC 2 summary and the redacted report under NDA?
- We can provide the POC dataset by 2026-03-10, owner: Data Platform (I'll loop them if helpful).

Adding procurement on cc (procurement@fintechco.com) — they mentioned they also prefer an editable SOW to expedite internal redlines.

Procurement intake form attached (procurement_intake_ftco.docx).

Samantha Wu
Head of Product Ops | FinTechCo
Samantha Wu <samantha@fintechco.com>
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Wu <samantha@fintechco.com>, Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@fintechco.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP draft + target close alignment

Thanks Samantha — appreciate the clarity.

If procurement needs signature by 2026-03-22 we can make that work, but we'll need to tighten the internal milestones on our side:
- Redwood will deliver final pricing and editable SOW by 2026-03-12. Owner: Aditya (pricing) + Camila (SOW)
- FinTechCo delivers POC dataset by 2026-03-10 (as noted). Owner: FinTechCo Data Platform
- Run a two-day performance validation window 2026-03-15–2026-03-16
- Final contract redlines complete by 2026-03-19 to allow signature routing on 2026-03-22

Camila / Aditya — can you confirm availability to meet the 2026-03-12 deliverable? Also attaching a slightly updated MAP (FinTechCo_MAP_v0.3.xlsx) where I moved the contract signature to 2026-03-22 and tightened some dates.

Quoted for context:
> On Thu, Feb 26, 2026 at 9:04 AM Samantha Wu <samantha@fintechco.com> wrote:
> > Procurement needs the contract signature by 2026-03-22 to align with our month-end budget release.

Marissa
From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Samantha Wu <samantha@fintechco.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@fintechco.com
Date: Wed, 04 Mar 2026 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP draft + target close alignment

Marissa / Samantha —

Confirming FinTechCo can commit to the procurement signature date of 2026-03-22 IF Redwood provides the final editable SOW and confirmed pricing by 2026-03-12. That gives our legal team time to review and route for signature.

We'll mobilize Data Platform to deliver the POC dataset by 2026-03-10 and procurement will prepare the PO template. Please send the updated MAP and SOW to procurement@fintechco.com and legal@fintechco.com when ready.

Thanks — looking forward to the POC.
Oliver Grant
VP, Engineering | FinTechCo
oliver.grant@fintechco.com
